title: plugins: the business-unit member reads in sharing and approvals still stop at 10,000 rows and answer "nobody" on a failed read; the queue member and approver-index reads stop at their caps
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope findings of the #29503 dev (os-dev-report `6588119628`, `out_of_scope_findings` items 1 and 2). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (business units past 10,000 members are rare; same family as #29362 / #29503).

## What happens (source reading, not reproduced through a public door)

After PR #29602 (#29503), the team, position and role-holder reads in sharing and approvals read to completion and refuse a failed read. The same family still answers short or empty in these places:

1. **`sys_business_unit_member`:**
   - plugin-sharing `business-unit-graph.ts` (around L186 and L217) and `primary-bu-projection.ts` (around L140) read at a 10,000-row bound.
   - plugin-approvals `expandBusinessUnitUsers` reads at `limit: 10000`, with a catch that answers `[]`.
2. **Caps that are not completion reads:**
   - The queue service reads `sys_queue_member` at `QUEUE_READ_LIMIT` (10,000).
   - Approvals `organizationAdministrators` reads at `APPROVER_INDEX_CAP` and warns when the cap is hit.
   Measure whether either can drop a real holder, and report it before changing either one.

## Wanted

- Item 1: each read reads to completion through `keysetWalk` (`@objectstack/types`) and refuses a failed or truncated read, exactly as #29362 and #29503 do. Absence is checked with `isObjectAbsentError` (`@objectstack/types`, added by #29503) and still answers no holders.
- Item 2: measure first. If a cap can silently drop a holder, take the same treatment. If the cap is a declared bound with a loud warning, report that and leave it.
- Add pins at 9,999 and 10,001 rows, plus one for a failed read, at each site that changes.
- ⛔ No new export from `@objectstack/core`.

Level: a read that answered "nobody" and now refuses is a narrowing. Expect `!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and the full dogfood battery.

Serial: after PR #29602 merges (same packages and helpers). If it touches `ownership-queue-service.ts`, also wait for the queue-posture card filed beside this one.

Dedupe: searched `sys_business_unit_member limit 10000`, `expandBusinessUnitUsers catch`; nearest #29503, #29362. **New.**

Links back: #29503, #29602, #29362.
